Every ignored error (`_, _`) is a lie you're telling yourself. Payment fails silently? You charge the card but never know if inventory was checked.

Line 91 writes to cache without mutex. Line 100-107 reads without mutex. Concurrent requests will corrupt your data.

## Medium Severity

**Using float64 for Money (Lines 26, 48-51)**

Floating point arithmetic will lose you money. Use integers (cents) or `decimal` types.

**Response Body Never Closed (Lines 52, 63)**

Memory leak. Every HTTP call leaves resources dangling.

```go

```

**Unbounded Cache Growth (Line 91)**

Cache grows forever. No TTL, no eviction. Eventually OOM kills your service.

**Loop Variable Capture (Lines 137-142)**

Classic Go bug—`productID` and `quantity` captured by reference, not value. All goroutines see the last iteration's values.
